old_route_audit: The nonabelian index-two coordinates are correct. Finite scans do not prove closure, and quasirandom mixing gives only a standard product-growth corollary.
new_result: After normalization, A^{-1}CA is contained in V and the exact dual inclusion AD'A^{-1} is contained in U holds; AD' and CA are disjoint. Hence A union cA and A union Ad double A without enlarging the corresponding one-sided difference set.
rejected_claim: Although BNP mixing yields r c <= N^2/D and the formal condition D>=11r would beat 253/225, it is vacuous because D<=sqrt(N-1)<sqrt(2)r under N<2r^2.
remaining_gap: A stabilizer or energy theorem for the two-sided no-growth extensions is needed; neither the Cayley subclass nor general h_3 is closed.
publication_potential: low-to-medium as a component; no nonvacuous numerical improvement
